newsitem.title: USA: Johnstown America expects to issue note.
newsitem.headline: Johnstown America expects to issue note.

text.p: Johnstown America Industries Inc said Thursday it expects to issue $75 million of 11.75 percent senior subordinated notes.

The new notes would carry the same terms and conditions as the $100 million of 11.75 percent senior subordinated notes issued by the company in August 1995, and would mature at the same time as such notes in August 2005.
Johnstown said it expects the new notes would be issued at a premium.

The net proceeds would be used to prepay senior bank debt and would result in a substantial reduction in senior indebtedness, strengthening the company's capital structure. The proposed refinancing would eliminate $6.6 million of the $8.3 million debt amortization in 1997 and substantially reduce the required future debt amortization through 2002, Johnstown said.
Johnstown America has three operating groups: truck components and assemblies operations, iron castings operations, and freight cars.
